name: Pay Per Call Extractor
description: A pay-per-call web extraction API settled through x402. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with the exact price and pay-to address; the agent pays and retries with proof of payment. No signup and no API key.

endpoints.description: Extract clean text and markdown from any web page URL.
endpoints.response_description: JSON with title, text content, markdown, and page metadata.

agent_notes: No account and no api key or other authentication is needed. Pricing: 5 free calls per day, then each call costs 0.0001 XNO. An unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with the amount and pay-to account; settle the payment and retry with the X-PAYMENT header. Check the payment requirements before each call to stay within budget.
